a260913p1.summary: As noted by Nicolas Lellouche, who writes for the French tech website Numerama, Apple has updated its tech specs pages …
a260913p1.title: Apple says its C2 modem is used in iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro worldwide, and in overseas iPhone 18 Pro Max models; US iPhone 18 Pro Max uses a Qualcomm modem (Joe Rossignol/MacRumors)

a260913p2.summary: As rules about heat and lightning grow nationwide, the Uptown Dallas company is betting AI and automation can take the guesswork out of calls regarding severe weather.
a260913p2.title: Dallas-based Perry Weather, a weather monitoring software provider, raised a $110M Series C led by Silversmith Capital Partners, taking total funding to ~$131M (John Egan/Dallas Innovates)

a260913p3.summary: The Interior secretary is quietly meeting with AI hyperscalers while seeking to accommodate them on his department's land. — Copy
a260913p3.title: Sources: US Interior Secretary Doug Burgum is quietly meeting with AI hyperscalers to advance Trump's push for data centers on federal lands, despite a backlash (The Washington Sun)

a260913p4.summary: Low-profile venture capital firm Vy Capital has emerged as one of the rocket maker's largest shareholders
a260913p4.title: Filing: Vy Capital owns a 3.4% SpaceX stake; Vy is also the largest outside investor in BoringCo and Neuralink and committed $700M to Musk's Twitter acquisition (Ivan Levingston/Financial Times)
